title: [Master][all-e]Purchase Invoice Statistics Non-Deductible VAT Amount does not match VAT Entries and G/L Entries when Non-Deductible VAT is enabled.
summary: Fixed a discrepancy where purchase invoice statistics showed different non-deductible VAT amounts than VAT entries and G/L entries by preserving document-allocated VAT amounts for manual entries and restricting recalculation to automatic journal VAT entries.
key_points: Purchase invoice statistics now correctly matches VAT entries and G/L entries when non-deductible VAT is enabled
Non-deductible VAT allocations from document posting are preserved for manual VAT entries
Recalculation of non-deductible VAT is restricted to automatic journal entries only
Resolves rounding differences caused by line splitting and dimension changes
Regression tests added for purchase invoices, credit memos, and various VAT scenarios
quote: Purchase Invoice Statistics Non-Deductible VAT Amount does not match VAT Entries and G/L Entries when Non-Deductible VAT is enabled.
